sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (deployed)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 2 x Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. All photos and videos will be sent at the end of the shift report.
No patrol entries were recorded for the morning shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift — Beni, Henry (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. Guards: Beni, Henry. All photos and videos will be sent at the end of the shift report.
Arrived at HQ; had a briefing with the morning shift and got our equipment ready.
Equipment checked and ready. Started patrols from HQ towards Lower Queen Street.
Patrolling Lower Queen Street; welfare checks completed, staff all okay, no issues:
Continued patrol through Lower Queen Street towards Victoria Street; checked surrounding retail businesses. All clear.
Due to the weather, patrols will be limited to sheltered areas unless urgent assistance is needed.
Patrolling Victoria Street West towards High Street; welfare checks completed at 77 Convenience Store and LookSharp. Staff okay, no issues.
Continued through High Street and Vulcan Lane; welfare checks completed at Tatty's and other High Street shop. All clear.
Continued towards Fort Street and Fort Lane; welfare check completed at Jo & Joe's. Staff okay, no issues.
Patrolling Gore Street towards Customs Street East. Area checked. All clear.
Continued along Customs Street East towards Commercial Bay; welfare check completed at Custom Mart. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; completed a full check of the area and surrounding entrances; welfare checks completed at Britomart McDonald's and Reign & Pour. All staff well, no issues.
Continuing patrols, heading towards Lower Albert Street.
Patrolling Lower Albert Street and Customs Street West. Area checked. All clear.
Continued through Albert Street and Victoria Street West; welfare check completed at Albert Mart. Area checked, all clear.
Returned to Queen Street and continued towards Wyndham Street.
Patrolling Wyndham Street; welfare check completed at Chemist Warehouse. All clear.
Lower Queen Street patrol completed; welfare checks completed along the route. Continuing patrols, heading towards Upper Queen Street.
Patrolling Upper Queen Street; welfare checks completed at Nike, Cotton On, Foot Locker and Queen Street McDonald's. Staff all okay, no issues.
Continued patrol through Upper Queen Street and checked in on stores. All clear.
Continuing towards Darby Street; welfare check completed at Recycle Boutique. Staff okay, no issues.
Continued through Elliot Street; welfare check completed at Elliot Stables. All clear.
Patrolling Wellesley Street West and checking the surrounding area. All clear.
Continuing towards Aotea Square. Area checked. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square; started a full check of the area.
Aotea Square check completed. All clear. Standing by at Aotea Square.
Continuing patrols, heading towards Rutland Street.
Patrolling Rutland Street and Lorne Street. Area checked. All clear.
Received a response call about a couple fighting in public at the intersection of Victoria Street and Queen Street. Responded straight away.
Arrived at the location within two minutes. Checked the area. All clear when we arrived.
Continuing patrols, heading towards Victoria Street East.
Patrolling Victoria Street East and Victoria Street West. Area checked. All clear.
Continuing through Albert Street and Wellesley Street West. Area checked. All clear.
Patrolling Federal Street and Wyndham Street. Area checked. All clear.
Received a response call from Red Radisson Security about people drinking in public across from the hotel. Responded straight away.
Arrived at the location within eight minutes. Checked the area, but the people were no longer there. No further action needed.
Continuing patrols, heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; completed a full check of the area. All clear.
Received a response call from Red Radisson Security about a possible assault in the upstairs bar. Responded to the location.
Arrived at the location and stood outside the upstairs bar to provide security support.
Completed 30 minutes of security support outside the bar. No further issues. Continuing patrols, heading towards Rutland Street.
Patrolling Rutland Street and Lorne Street. Area checked. All clear.
Continuing through Victoria Street East and Victoria Street West. Area checked. All clear.
Patrolling Albert Street and Wellesley Street West. Area checked. All clear.
Started making our way back to HQ for the scheduled floor check.
Arrived back at the office and prepared for the floor check.
Started the floor check of the office.
Completed floor check. Starting our 30-minute break and finishing off our reports.
Received a call from Red Radisson Security regarding people drinking in public and aggressive people upstairs.
Arrived at Red Radisson; told the people drinking in public to move further down the street. Standing by outside Red Radisson maintaining presence.
Heading back to headquarters for shift changeover.
Shift concluded. Equipment checked and returned. Handover to night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. All photos and videos will be sent at the end of the shift report.
Check-in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu. No issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete. All clear. Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone.
Arrived at HQ charging ops phone; phone has died.
Check-in Albert St Convenience Store. No issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square; commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete. All clear. Alpha Route complete.
Check-in Queen St Maccas. No issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Sq / Kitchener St. All clear.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson Carpark. All clear.
Full sweep Quay St. All clear.
Welfare check marina guards. No issues.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral church. All clear.
Full sweep Victoria St. All clear.
Check-in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield. No issues.

Check-in Queen St Maccas; on arrival a few vagrants had shortly before come in to sleep inside, so we removed 4 vagrants from the premises, kindly asked them to leave, and they complied. On standby waiting for them to move along.
Vagrants have moved along and gained distance from the premises. No further issues. Heading back to HQ for 30-minute break.
Break ended. Heading back out on patrols.
Check-in St Patrick's Cathedral church. All clear.
Full sweep Wyndham St. All clear.
Full sweep Durham St. All clear.
Check-in Freyberg / Chancery Square. No issues.
Check-in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay. All clear. Heading back to HQ for changeover.
